manual_runtime_precondition: Open Groundline in Chrome 149+ with #enable-webmcp-testing enabled.
Click Try the example so experienceMode is DEMO before executing any WebMCP tool.
Do not reload, reset, or return to START during the five-tool journey.
runtime_acceptance: On START or INTAKE, inspect_workspace execution fails explicitly with 'No active Groundline workspace'.
On DEMO, all five P08 tools remain discoverable.
triage_workspace preserves 4 evaluations and 4 triage records.
focus_items(A-001, C-001, CONC-001; primary A-001) selects A-001 in ReactFlow and Inspector.
inspect_workspace after focus reports primary_focus_id=A-001 and primary_risk_id=A-001.
propose_revision(CONC-001) creates exactly one PROPOSED revision and does not change accepted knowledge.
inspect_workspace after proposal reports selected_item_id=CONC-001, primary_risk_id=A-001, repair_target_id=CONC-001.
Final audit order is EVALUATE, TRIAGE, FOCUS, PROPOSE_REVISION.
Human decision controls remain required for acceptance.
